svg.title: Workstation
svg.desc: Scientific workstation with monitor, plotted analysis, keyboard, mouse, tower, and data indicators. Biological basis: A workstation icon is grounded by recognizable input devices and a display showing scientific analysis rather than a generic screen glyph.
